# Lacarte Atlas Console - Comprehensive Project Analysis

## 1. Project Introduction

### Purpose Statement
Lacarte Atlas Console is a comprehensive administrative dashboard application built with Nuxt.js, designed to manage waste collection logistics operations. The platform provides administrators with tools to manage customers, drivers, trucks, pickup requests, billing, and operational analytics.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Operational Management**: Centralized control over waste collection services including customer management, driver assignments, and truck fleet management
- **Real-time Tracking**: Live monitoring of active trucks and pickup operations
- **Financial Oversight**: Billing management, payment tracking, and revenue analytics
- **Team Administration**: Role-based access control and team member management
- **Customer Support**: Integrated support ticket system and communication tools

### Target Audience
- Administrative users managing waste collection operations
- Operations managers overseeing daily logistics
- Customer service representatives handling support tickets
- Financial administrators managing billing and payments

## 2. Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern Vue 3 + Nuxt.js architecture with TypeScript, implementing a clean separation of concerns and modular design patterns.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Client Browser] --> B[Nuxt.js Application]
    B --> C[Authentication Middleware]
    B --> D[Permission Middleware]
    B --> E[API Layer (useApi)]
    
    C --> F[Auth Store (Pinia)]
    D --> G[Permission System]
    E --> H[Backend API]
    
    F --> I[Session Management]
    G --> J[Role-Based Access Control]
    E --> K[Error Handling]
    
    L[UI Components] --> M[Dashboard Layout]
    L --> N[Feature Modules]
    M --> O[Navigation & Sidebar]
    N --> P[CRUD Operations]
    N --> Q[Data Visualization]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Core Architecture Layers:**
- **Presentation Layer**: Vue 3 components with Composition API
- **State Management**: Pinia stores with persistence
- **API Layer**: Centralized HTTP client with error handling
- **Security Layer**: Authentication and permission middleware
- **UI Framework**: @nuxt/ui component library

### Design Patterns

**Repository Pattern**: The `useApi` composable implements a centralized API layer that abstracts HTTP requests and handles authentication tokens automatically.

**Observer Pattern**: Session management uses reactive state with automatic refresh intervals and warning notifications.

**Strategy Pattern**: Permission system supports multiple authorization strategies (role-based and permission-based).

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client as Frontend Client
    participant Auth as Auth Middleware
    participant Perm as Permission Middleware
    participant API as API Layer
    participant Backend as Backend API
    
    Client->>+Auth: Request Protected Route
    Auth->>+AuthStore: Check Authentication
    AuthStore-->>-Auth: Auth Status
    Auth->>+Perm: Check Permissions
    Perm->>+AuthStore: Get User Data
    AuthStore-->>-Perm: User Permissions
    Perm-->>-Auth: Permission Result
    Auth-->>-Client: Route Access Granted/Denied
    
    Client->>+API: API Request
    API->>+AuthStore: Get Token
    AuthStore-->>-API: JWT Token
    API->>+Backend: HTTP Request with Auth
    Backend-->>-API: Response
    API-->>-Client: Processed Response
```

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Application Bootstrap**: `app/app.vue` - Root component managing global UI state, authentication loading, and session warnings.

**Configuration**: `nuxt.config.ts` - Central configuration for modules, runtime config, routing rules, and build optimization.

**Layout System**: 
- `app/layouts/default.vue` - Basic layout wrapper
- `app/layouts/dashboard.vue` - Main dashboard layout with sidebar navigation

### Core Modules

**Authentication System**: `app/stores/auth.ts` - Comprehensive auth store managing user sessions, token refresh, and profile data synchronization.

**API Layer**: `app/composables/useApi.ts` - Centralized HTTP client with automatic authentication, error handling, and response processing.

**Permission System**: 
- `app/utils/auth.ts` - Core permission utilities and role validation
- `app/composables/usePermissions.ts` - Reactive permission checking composable

### Configuration Approach

**Environment Configuration**: Runtime configuration through `runtimeConfig.public` for API endpoints and external service keys.

**Module Integration**: 
- `@nuxt/ui` for component library
- `@pinia/nuxt` for state management
- `@pinia-plugin-persistedstate/nuxt` for local storage persistence

### External Dependencies

**Core Framework**: Nuxt.js 4.x with Vue 3.5+ and TypeScript
**UI Components**: @nuxt/ui v4.5.1 with Lucide icons
**State Management**: Pinia with persistence plugin
**Mapping**: TomTom Maps SDK for location services
**Testing**: Vitest with Vue Test Utils and Happy DOM

### Integration Points

**Authentication Endpoints**:
- `/auth/sign-in/email` - User authentication
- `/auth/get-session` - Session validation
- `/auth/sign-out` - User logout
- `/user/profile` - Team member profile data

**Business APIs**:
- `/pickup-requests/admin/list` - Pickup request management
- `/trucks/admin/` - Truck fleet management
- Various CRUD endpoints for customers, drivers, billing, and support

### Component Relationship Diagram

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[App.vue] --> B[AuthLoadingScreen]
    A --> C[NuxtLayout]
    C --> D[Dashboard Layout]
    D --> E[AppSidebar]
    D --> F[AppHeader]
    D --> G[Page Content]
    
    E --> H[Navigation Links]
    H --> I[Permission Guards]
    
    F --> J[User Menu]
    F --> K[Notifications]
    
    G --> L[Feature Pages]
    L --> M[Modals & Forms]
    L --> N[Data Tables]
    L --> O[Charts & Analytics]
```

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Dashboard Analytics**: Real-time metrics display with revenue charts, pickup volume tracking, and operational statistics.

**Customer Management**: Complete CRUD operations for customer accounts with subscription management and billing integration.

**Fleet Management**: Driver and truck assignment, status tracking, and maintenance scheduling.

**Pickup Operations**: Request management, assignment workflows, and delivery tracking.

**Billing & Payments**: Subscription management, payment processing, and financial reporting.

**Support System**: Ticket management, communication tools (SMS/Email), and customer service workflows.

### Implementation Highlights

**Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with collapsible sidebar and adaptive layouts.

**Real-time Updates**: WebSocket-ready architecture with polling for live tracking features.

**Advanced Filtering**: Complex query builders for data tables with search, sort, and pagination.

**Form Validation**: Comprehensive validation with custom rules and error handling.

**Export Capabilities**: Excel export functionality for reports and data analysis.

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Unauthenticated
    Unauthenticated --> Loading: Login Attempt
    Loading --> Authenticated: Valid Credentials
    Loading --> Error: Invalid Credentials
    Error --> Unauthenticated: Retry
    
    Authenticated --> Dashboard: Default Route
    Authenticated --> FeatureModule: Navigate
    FeatureModule --> Dashboard: Back Navigation
    FeatureModule --> AnotherModule: Cross-navigation
    
    Dashboard --> SessionWarning: Near Expiry
    SessionWarning --> Authenticated: Extend Session
    SessionWarning --> Unauthenticated: Expired
    
    Authenticated --> Unauthorized: Insufficient Permissions
    Unauthorized --> Authenticated: Permission Granted
```

**Security Implementation**: Multi-layered security with route guards, permission checks, and session management.

**Performance Optimization**: Code splitting, lazy loading, and optimized builds with Vite.

**Testing Strategy**: Comprehensive test suite covering utilities, validation logic, and component behavior.
